settings.prompt.spellcheckHelp: Independent of interface language. Uses local system dictionaries; the selected dictionary must be installed.
settings.prompt.autocompleteHelp: Off by default. Uses Prompt Forge’s local tag database; requires a configured environment and its tag data. Type at least two characters, use arrows and Enter/Tab to choose; Escape dismisses.
settings.prompt.dictionaryMissing: No dictionary for the selected language is installed. Install its system spelling dictionary, then toggle spellcheck off/on.
settings.prompt.unsupported: This WebView cannot configure an independent spelling dictionary. Spelling hints depend on the operating system and WebView runtime.
settings.prompt.failed: Could not configure spellcheck. See Logs for details.
